name: Deployment Configurations Support - Fabric Warehouse
description: * *support of deployment configurations — giving teams granular control over what gets deployed, what gets skipped, and how data is handled at deployment time. Configurations are stored in Git alongside your warehouse schema, making them version controlled and consistent across every deployment.*

result.nameEs: Configuraciones de despliegue en Fabric Warehouse
result.descriptionEs: Las configuraciones de despliegue darán control detallado sobre qué se despliega, qué se omite y cómo se tratan los datos durante el despliegue. Se guardan en Git junto al esquema del warehouse, con control de versiones y coherencia entre despliegues.
